hypotheses.justification: The statement and the proof via `groupCohomology_res_padicCompletionUnits` do not use this local-field assumption on K. The representation and cohomology expression only require the other hypotheses; this is also reflected in the source theorem’s variable context, which does not include local-field assumptions on K. The neighboring `[ValuativeRel K]` and `[TopologicalSpace K]` must remain to elaborate the remaining local-field-related binder types, but this binder itself can be omitted.

This is implied by `[Field K]` and `[Algebra ℚ_[p] K]`: the algebra map from the characteristic-zero field ℚ_[p] into the field K is injective, so `charZero_of_injective_algebraMap` supplies `CharZero K`. The proof and statement can use that derived instance instead.

This is implied by `[Field L]` and `[Algebra ℚ_[p] L]` in the same way: the algebra map from ℚ_[p] into L is injective, and `charZero_of_injective_algebraMap` supplies `CharZero L`. The proof can use the derived instance instead.
